description:
## Why
Each twin differs from its fixture only by IO.inspect(..., width: :infinity) (01062 x2, 01064 x2, 01077 x16, 01281 x1): fz prints a long collection on one line where Elixir's default IO.inspect wraps at 80 columns.

## What changes
Once fz-sc8.162 wraps at 80 columns, each fixture is wrapped in defmodule Main (dbg -> IO.inspect), its header reads `# oracle: self`, its twin is deleted and its golden is regenerated with ORACLE=regen. A golden whose bytes change is a finding to report, not to bless.

## Signal
Four fewer .oracle.exs files; fixture_matrix run/interp/build and ORACLE=check pass for the four stems.
title: Fixtures 01062, 01064, 01077 and 01281 are their own Elixir oracle
